layout_diagnosis.before: The dock root was a VBoxContainer and every control was added directly to it. There was no ScrollContainer, so the result list, preview/details, and placement controls pushed the action buttons below the visible dock area.
layout_diagnosis.after: The title/status remain at the top and the main content lives in a MainScroll ScrollContainer with ContentVBox sections for Search / Filters, Results, Selected Object, Placement, and Actions.

manual_test_checklist: Enable or re-enable PVGames Object Palette plugin.
Open the dock in a short/narrow editor layout.
Search for wall and filter OccludableObjects.
Confirm Dry Run Stamp and stamp buttons are reachable.
Click Dry Run Stamp and confirm no object is stamped.
Open PVGamesObjectPaletteDockTest.tscn and stamp one object intentionally.
recommended_next_step: Re-enable the plugin in Godot and verify the dock scrolls to the Actions section in the normal editor layout.
